text:
toni: quick report from the new-node-sample onboarding: embed batching helper produced mismatched vector dims when a retry kicked in. sent 2 items (expected dim=1536) but got back one 1536 vector and one null. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-embed-dim

brad: can you paste the request/response headers? sounds like positional remap bug when chunk-level retry happens.

toni: request: POST /v1/embeddings body { inputs: [u1,u2], batch_size:2, client_batch_id: 'b-42' } response: { data: [ {embedding: [/*1536*/]}, null ], warnings: ["partial_success"] }

yuki: node helper's batcher attaches callbacks by array position and resolves by slice index. if retry requeues part of the slice the mapping is off. python uses per-item callback ids. this is a parity hole.

sam: another wrinkle: on the retry the client sent Authorization header again and server returned 200 but with response.data where second slot was omitted (partial success) instead of returning an error. client appended results assuming full length.

toni: reproduction steps in gist include a stubbed auth service that returns 401 on the first attempt then 200 on retry. very reliable locally.

brad: short-term: update sampleapp README to recommend EMBED_BATCH=1 or to set NODE_EMBED_RETRY=false. ticket that in docs.

yuki: long-term fix: change node batch helper to inject a per-item property __rwd_item_id into each input and map responses by that id. add an opt-in config "preserveItemIds" default false for backward compat.

sam: also add defensive check in helper: if any data[i] is null, surface a structured error to the caller rather than silently returning nulls. and add a debug log with original request ids and chunk ids.

build-bot: ci queued: redwood/node PR #1450 (batcher-item-id-map) job 9988

brad: we should also make the server more strict: if partial success occurs, return 207 with per-item status so clients can reconcile. but that's a bigger API change.
toni: filed issue: redwood/node#1450 with logs, repro and suggested patch. linked here.
yuki: I'll open the PR and include unit tests that simulate intermittent 401 mid-batch and ensure final order matches input order and no nulls are returned to callers.

sam: one more: sampleapp's parser assumed data[i].embedding (singular) but an older runtime returned data[i].embeddings (plural). sampleapp now accepts both keys and emits a deprecation warning.

brad: thanks team. greatly improves onboarding DX to avoid confusing missing vectors. :tada:
